content.title: 2026 golf calendar and schedule: Majors and biggest tournaments on the men’s and women’s tours
content.text: Explore the 2026 golf calendar with the men’s and women’s majors, leading PGA and LPGA tour events, and major team competitions.Picture by Andrew Redington/Getty ImagesBy Will Imbo 12 March 2026 12:53 GMT-53 min readThe 2026 golf season features a packed calendar of tournaments across the men’s and women’s tours. From the sport’s major championships to flagship tour events and international team competitions, the year will see many of golf’s biggest tournaments played on some of the game’s most iconic courses. Check out the key competitions on the men’s and women’s calendars below, including dates and venues.Key golf tournaments in 2026: dates and venues Women’s tournaments 26 February–1 March 2026 — HSBC Women’s World Championship — Sentosa Golf Club (Tanjong Course), Singapore 23–26 April 2026 — Chevron Championship — Memorial Park Golf Course, Houston, Texas, USA [Major] 7–10 May 2026 — Mizuho Americas Open — Mountain Ridge Country Club, West Caldwell, New Jersey, USA 4–7 June 2026 — U.S. Women’s Open — Riviera Country Club, Pacific Palisades, California, USA [Major] 25–28 June 2026 — KPMG Women’s PGA Championship — Hazeltine National Golf Club, Chaska, Minnesota, USA [Major] 9–12 July 2026 — Amundi Evian Championship — Evian Resort Golf Club, Evian-les-Bains, France [Major] 23–26 July 2026 — ISPS Handa Women’s Scottish Open — Dundonald Links, North Ayrshire, Scotland 30 July–2 August 2026 — AIG Women’s Open — Royal Lytham & St Annes Golf Club, England [Major] 11–13 September 2026 — Solheim Cup — Bernardus Golf, Cromvoirt, Netherlands [Team event] 19–22 November 2026 — CME Group Tour Championship — Tiburón Golf Club, Naples, Florida, USA [Season finale] Golf -
